About the position

As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice (by travelling) factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

You will:

  • Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
  • Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
  • Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
  • Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
  • Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
  • Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
  • Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
  • Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
  • Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
  • Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
  • Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
  • Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
  • Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
  • Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  

You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).</li> <li>Scripting &amp; Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.</li> <li>Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.</li> <li>Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.</li> <li>Expertise with a scripting language like Python.</li> <li>Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).</li> <li>Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).</li> <li>Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.</li> <li>Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.</li> <li>Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming</li> <li>Experience with version control e.g. Git.</li> <li>Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.</li> <li>Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.</li> <li>Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.</li> <li>Experience with&nbsp; Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>December 8, 2026 by 11:59p / 23:59 CET (Central European Time)</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by the Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commission, and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€77.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€96.300 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Netherlands Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€93.700 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Slovenia Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€64.900</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€81.100 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p><strong>This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Loki Query&nbsp; | EMEA | Remote</strong></h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack</p> <p>The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are<a href="https://github.com/grafana/mimir"> Mimir for metrics</a>,<a href="https://github.com/grafana/loki"> Loki for logs</a>,<a href="https://github.com/grafana/tempo"> Tempo for traces</a>, and<a href="https://github.com/grafana/pyroscope"> Pyroscope for profiles</a>. Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on<a href="https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus"> Prometheus</a>,<a href="https://github.com/grafana/agent"> Grafana Agent</a>,<a href="https://grafana.com/blog/2022/07/25/new-in-grafana-mimir-ingest-graphite-datadog-influx-and-prometheus-metrics-into-a-single-storage-backend/"> Mimir proxies</a>, and OpenTelemetry.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage.</p> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.<br><br>We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.<br><br>You’ll also have access to frontier models (e.g., GPT-Codex 5/3, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro).</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives&nbsp;</li> <li>Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.</li> <li>Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers</li> <li>Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope</li> <li>Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability</li> <li>Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running</li> <li>Supporting other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team</li> <li>Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system</li> </ul> <p>As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.</p> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action</li> <li>You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs&nbsp;</li> <li>Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively</li> <li>Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well</li> <li>Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way</li> <li>Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud <em>or</em> some experience with systems engineering</li> <li>Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with Kubernetes and/or Docker</li> <li>Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects)</li> <li>Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, and a desire to learn</li> <li>Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is €97,000 - €121,000.&nbsp; Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed <a class="c-link" href="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2>What this job can offer you</h2> <p>As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
description: Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care. Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module. You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue. Where we are Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead. You will: Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model. Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work. Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant. Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved. Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions. Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible. Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it. You bring: Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases). Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags). Reporting. raw.title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
raw.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. The ideal candidate holds a degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, or a related field, although equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Candidates should have at least two years of experience in technical support, ideally within Fintech, Banking, Financial Services, or another technically complex environment. Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience supporting gateways and card processing, troubleshooting APIs and integration errors, investigating logs and data, and diagnosing transaction issues. They should be able to interpret technical evidence, identify patterns, and apply a structured approach to problem solving. Strong communication skills are essential, as the role involves managing complex merchant enquiries and collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders. The merchant is always at the centre of our work. We are looking for people with experience in, and a genuine desire to work in, customer support, helping merchants remove blockers and improve their results. Successful candidates demonstrate ownership, a strong sense of urgency, technical curiosity, and a commitment to quality. Comprehensive payments training will be provided, so prior payments experience is not required where the candidate has a strong technical support and troubleshooting foundation. The Team Merchant Product Support is a specialised global technical support function that sits between frontline support and specialist Product or Engineering teams in the ticket flow. Our analysts are product specialists aligned to defined Checkout.com product areas and features. They work closely with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, improve product functionality, and strengthen the support experience for each product area. The team is primarily centred in London, with a strategic regional presence in Dublin, Mexico, Dubai, and Shanghai. This distribution provides broad coverage across multiple time zones and enables specialised support for merchants and internal teams. We are passionate about technology and use state-of-the-art AI capabilities to create better outcomes for our customers. We look for people who are curious, open to new ways of working, and eager to use AI as builders from the outset. Team members are encouraged to develop and improve AI-enabled tools that make technical investigations more effective and help accelerate solutions. Role Overview The Analyst I is the foundational specialist tier within Merchant Product Support. The role receives and manages merchant and internal requests across channels such as instant messaging, email, and web forms. Analysts acknowledge requests, investigate and resolve issues within their product scope, apply documented technical procedures, provide clear updates, and work in line with agreed SLAs and quality standards. When an issue requires deeper expertise, they engage the appropriate internal team or escalate to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst with clear evidence and relevant troubleshooting details. Troubleshooting is at the core of the role. Analysts investigate payment flows, system logs, transaction data, and other technical evidence to diagnose issues, identify recurring patterns, and understand emerging trends. Areas of investigation may include advanced financial investigations, payment transaction anomalies, REST API and integration errors, webhook failures, Vault and tokenisation issues, authentication, fraud detection logic, gateway and card processing issues, platform errors, and changes in payment performance or authorisation rates. The team also supports issues affecting payment methods such as PayPal, KNET, Klarna, SEPA, MB WAY, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. This is a specialist role supported by targeted training designed to build deep expertise in payment flows and enable consistently high-quality problem solving. Analysts use advanced tools and techniques for technical investigation and API debugging while developing the knowledge required to resolve issues efficiently and help merchants maintain successful payment operations. Quality Assurance: Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimize errors and provide consistent care. Issue Identification: Categorize global queue issues and identify repetitive problems, escalating the likely root causes to the wider team. Process Improvement: Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams. Product Onboarding: Actively participate in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products, reusable architectures, and technical patterns that help developers everywhere get more value from Codex.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. Success is measured by production systems, sustained developer adoption, and meaningful improvements to how engineering organizations build software—not simply successful demonstrations or enablement activity.

This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities for Codex and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered software development workflows that improve how engineering teams plan, write, test, review, debug, and deliver software.

  • Contribute to the strategy and delivery of the NS & Defence team, providing expert insights into customer needs and procurement trends, and supporting NS&D strategic campaigns across the waterfront of client delivery.  
  • Be a valued contributor to the evolution of Plexal’s GTM function, supporting process improvements and maturation of business development.


Your Skills

  • Able to operate autonomously as an individual contributor, delivering against GTM objectives and targets. 
  • Accountable for personal delivery, and able to work collaboratively in a wider GTM team contributing to overall NS&D objectives. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, able to develop rapport and strong relationships with clients, understand client needs and align Plexal to deliver against them.
  • A strategic thinker, able to understand long-term trends in clients and develop credible Plexal propositions. 
  • A collaborative worker, with a strong bias to supporting and enabling broader teams (both GTM and London-based Plexal colleagues). 


Your Experience

Essential: 

  • Proven track record of selling, winning new business and proposition development in National Security
  • Demonstrable experience of working directly with National Security clients, especially those located in London, including demonstration of client delivery and relationship-based sales
  • Extant, valid SC (essential), DV (preferred). NS sponsorship preferred.
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Strong understanding of NS sector procurement and commercial processes.
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
Desirable:
  • Experience of working on technology adoption, innovation ecosystems, or organisational change in government, especially National Security.
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 


Who You Are

Due to the nature of this position, our work and our client engagements, the post holder must be willing and eligible to achieve a minimum of SC clearance. Pre-existing SC clearance is welcome.


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day

It owns the integrity of the company's planning models, and that ownership sets the boundary with strategic finance: deal origination, valuation, and financing analysis sit outside core FP&amp;A, but every completed acquisition has to be absorbed into the operating plan, forecast, and reporting baseline this role owns. The two functions therefore work together from diligence onward rather than at handover, so that the assumptions underwriting a deal survive into the model the company plans against.</p> <p>The Senior Manager, FP&amp;A leads the FP&amp;A team and is accountable for its output quality, its operating model, and its capacity to scale with the business. The role is expected to make FP&amp;A AI-native: each planning and reporting cycle must become faster, more accurate, and better controlled through automation and AI-enabled workflows, within the systems and control framework that governs the wider finance function.</p> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What You'll Bring</span></strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>Forecasting and financial model architecture</strong> — Knowledge of driver-based forecasting, budgeting, scenario planning, investment analysis, and the design principles that keep a model auditable, maintainable, and able to absorb a new entity without being rebuilt. Applies this knowledge to convert pipeline and contract data into a revenue forecast and commission forecast that hold up to scrutiny.</li> <li><strong>Headcount, cost, and cash planning</strong> — Knowledge of personnel planning and costing, non-personnel opex, capex, cost allocation, and the FX exposure and entity-level cost flows that shape a multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction forecast. Applies this knowledge to build personnel and non-personnel budgets and a cash-flow forecast that reconcile to actuals.</li> <li><strong>Management and board reporting</strong> — Knowledge of KPI design, variance analysis, management reporting structure, and the conventions of board and investor packs. Applies this knowledge to produce reporting that leadership plans against, with the analysis behind each number ready when challenged.</li> <li><strong>FP&amp;A systems, data, and automation</strong> — Knowledge of planning tools, data flows from finance, CRM, and HR systems, workflow automation, and AI-enabled analysis. Applies this knowledge to identify where manual effort and error enter the planning and reporting cycle and to select the tooling that removes them</li> </ol> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What You'll Do</span></strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>FP&amp;A team leadership and operating model</strong> — Leads the FP&amp;A team by owning model responsibilities, the planning calendar, review controls, documentation, data flows, hiring, coaching, and role design, so that the function scales while maintaining consistent output quality without dependency on any single analyst.</li> <li><strong>Budgeting and re-forecasting</strong> — Owns the annual budget and re-forecast cadence end to end by establishing assumptions with functional leaders and translating Sales, RevOps, and People inputs into controlled pipeline-to-revenue bridges, personnel and non-personnel budgets, commission forecasts, opex, and capex, so that each planning cycle delivers a controlled financial baseline on the agreed calendar.</li> <li><strong>Financial modelling, scenario analysis, and acquisition integration</strong> — Builds, maintains, and reviews the operating plan, forecast, cash-flow, scenario, and acquisition-integration models by testing model logic and sensitivities, reconciling deal assumptions to post-close actuals, and establishing the combined baseline for completed acquisitions, so that the company plans against maintainable models that preserve deal assumptions and show performance against the acquisition case.</li> <li><strong>Management, board, and investor reporting</strong> — Drives the management reporting cycle and financial analysis for board and investor packs by translating variance to plan into operational drivers and stating the resulting implications for the forecast, so that leadership can use the reporting directly to make planning decisions.</li> <li><strong>Planning process automation</strong> — Drives automation and AI-enabled workflows by redesigning data collection, plan consolidation, variance analysis, and report production and measuring changes in cycle time, error rate, and analyst hours, so that planning and reporting become faster and better controlled while analyst capacity shifts from data handling to analysis.</li> </ol> <h3><strong><span data-sheets-root="1">What We Offer </span></strong></h3> title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
description: <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our architecture&nbsp;and approach&nbsp;is&nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&nbsp;don't&nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025,&nbsp;PsiQuantum&nbsp;closed a&nbsp;$1 billion&nbsp;funding round that valued the company at&nbsp;$7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative,&nbsp;PsiQuantum's&nbsp;most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive&nbsp;Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas&nbsp;Zennström.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum&nbsp;also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including&nbsp;Airbus,&nbsp;Lockheed&nbsp;Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&nbsp;represents&nbsp;a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&nbsp;solved&nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have&nbsp;the funding,&nbsp;the government&nbsp;validation, and&nbsp;the sites&nbsp;under construction to make it real.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1">Within the Quantum Algorithms team, we develop and adapt quantum algorithms, identify and scope promising use cases, and analyze their resource requirements. In this role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract quantum-algorithm specifications, analyze their asymptotic performance, and define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit implementations of these algorithms and evaluate their resource requirements on our architecture.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="582">In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research, but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that draw on the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives spanning PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1023">The role will also involve external collaboration. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, formulate them as well-defined problems, and map them to appropriate quantum algorithms. Success in this work requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1564">The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, assessing the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and a detailed resource estimate.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience/Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">5+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred. </li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment.</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>PsiQuantum provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. PsiQuantum does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable laws.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Note: PsiQuantum will only reach out to you using an official PsiQuantum email address and will never ask you for bank account information as part of the interview process. Please report any suspicious activity to </strong><strong data-stringify-type="bold"><a class="c-link" ----- target="_blank" ----- ----- data-stringify-type="bold">.</strong></p> <p>We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The ranges below reflect the target ranges for a new hire base salary.&nbsp;Actual compensation may vary outside of these ranges and is dependent on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's qualifications including relevant education and training, competencies, experience, geographic location, and business needs. Base pay is only one part of the total compensation package. Full time roles are eligible for equity and benefits. Base pay is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p></div><div class="title">Daresbury, United Kingdom </div><div class="pay-range"><span>£78,900</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£92,900 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
