title: UK Summer Internship 2027 - Public Sector Consulting
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="color: #00358e; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Government &amp; Public Sector team!</span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Internship</span></span></h3> <p>Our internship programmes will give you a first-hand view of life in an award-winning management consultancy firm. You will gain an understanding of the consulting business model as well as hands-on experience across the consulting project lifecycle, from understanding client challenges and analysing evidence through to developing recommendations and supporting delivery</p> <p>As an intern you will join a real team, working and learning from experienced consultants, with exposure to meaningful client work alongside a structured programme to learn more about Baringa and working as a consultant.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">About the Government team at Baringa</span></h3> <p>Our Government team helps departments, agencies and public services solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes for citizens. Our work spans Central Government, Home Affairs, and Health and Public Infrastructure, from redesigning services and strengthening operations to using data, technology and AI to improve decisions and delivery.</p> <p>We work on Government’s most complex changes, partnering with departments across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.</p> <p>The UK public sector is navigating significant challenges and opportunities, including the delivery of major national priorities and missions. As our Public Sector team continues to grow, we are looking for curious and motivated interns who are excited to learn, contribute and develop with us. You do not need previous consulting or public sector experience – we are interested in how you approach problems, learn new things and apply your skills to real-world challenges.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What you will be doing</span></h3> <p>We will embed you in a project for your internship period, working alongside a team of experienced consultants to learn whilst delivering real client outcomes. You will not be expected to know how to do all of this from day one. You will be supported throughout and given opportunities to build your skills through meaningful project work.</p> <p>Depending on the project you join, you may have the opportunity to:</p> <ul> <li>Analyse quantitative and qualitative information to identify insights, trends and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Explore how data, digital technology, automation or AI could help improve public services.</li> <li>Develop recommendations and delivery plans, considering how people, technology and data work together.</li> <li>Support the development of client materials, including presentations, reports, workshop outputs and project updates.</li> <li>Contribute to meetings and workshop discussions, helping to capture key points, actions and decisions.</li> <li>Learn how consulting teams work together to solve problems, structure ambiguous challenges and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.</li> </ul> <p>Examples of the type of projects you could be working on are:</p> <ul> <li>Support transformation projects that help government and public sector organisations improve services, strengthen operations and deliver better outcomes for citizens.</li> <li>Help review how services and processes work, from frontline delivery through to internal operations, identifying opportunities to make them simpler, more effective or more resilient.</li> <li>Contribute to digital, data and analytics work, including projects that use AI or data-led approaches to help clients make better decisions.</li> <li>Support the development of business cases and funding proposals, helping clients assess different options and make evidence-based decisions.</li> <li>Help design how services should operate, looking at how people, processes, technology and data come together to deliver better results within operating models and service blueprints.</li> <li>Support commercial and procurement activity, such as researching suppliers, comparing options and helping prepare materials for decision-making.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What are we looking for?</span></h3> <p>We welcome applications from students across a broad range of academic disciplines, including STEM and non-STEM subjects, and are particularly keen to hear from students who enjoy solving complex problems using evidence, data, technology and creative thinking. You do not need to have previous experience in consulting or the public sector - what matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in helping public sector organisations solve complex challenges.</p> <p>We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to learn how consulting teams work, contribute to meaningful client projects and develop their skills in a supportive environment. You may be a good fit if you bring:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Structured problem solving</strong>, with the ability to break down unfamiliar questions and identify what matters.</li> <li><strong>Data analysis skills</strong>, and comfort working with data to surface insight and support evidence-based recommendations.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Digital and AI literacy</strong>, with genuine curiosity about AI and its practical application, and a foundational understanding of how to use these tools responsibly and ethically.</li> <li><strong>Interest in policy, government and public service</strong>, and how national priorities translate into delivery on the ground.</li> <li><strong>Commercial and financial curiosity</strong>, with an interest in how money, value and delivery decisions shape public services, and comfort working with numbers to support them.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication skills</strong>, including the ability to explain ideas simply and structure your thinking in writing and conversation.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative approach</strong>, with enthusiasm for working in teams and learning from others.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to learn and adapt</strong>, particularly in a fast-paced project environment where priorities can evolve.</li> <li><strong>Attention to detail and ownership</strong>, taking pride in the quality of your work and following through on tasks.</li> <li><strong>A proactive attitude</strong>, with the confidence to ask questions, contribute ideas and get involved.</li> </ul> <p>We do not expect you to have all the answers from day one. We are looking for potential, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in developing your consulting skills while contributing to work that matters.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">What's in it for you?</span></h3> <p>An internship at Baringa is what you make it.</p> <p>This is an 8-week paid internship where you get real project experience alongside structured coaching and training with an opportunity to build your analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.</p> <p>You will leave the internship with practical consulting experience, a stronger understanding of public sector work, and a clearer view of whether consulting is the right career path for you. High performing interns may also be considered for a permanent role.</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Requirements</span></h3> <p>Applicants should be in their penultimate year of their bachelor’s or master’s Degree studies. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future and be eligible for a UK Security Check (SC) clearance. title: Marketing Lead - Public Sector
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. Our focus now spans from brand and market positioning through to deeper client relationships, improved win rates, revenue growth, and increased net margin. This is being underpinned by an operational transformation including&nbsp;cNPS, new ways of working, and a content management platform driving greater efficiency and effectiveness.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re&nbsp;now looking for the marketing and business development professionals that can guide us through this exciting transformation.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Partnering with the Clients &amp; Marketing Exec Sponsor and sector leadership teams to shape and deliver strategic marketing plans that advance sector priorities and drive measurable commercial impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>Leading the end‑to‑end delivery of campaign and event programmes, ensuring high‑quality execution and measurable commercial impact.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Building a strong understanding of client challenges, market trends, competitor activity, and Baringa’s sector capabilities to refine messaging, targeting, and segmentation.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Managing the in‑sector marketing team (where applicable), providing coaching, development, and day‑to‑day support.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Championing consistency, collaboration, and efficiency across sectors by working closely with fellow BPs and the wider Clients &amp; Marketing team.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Leading the creation of compelling messaging and visuals that clearly differentiate Baringa in the market. Leveraging thought leadership, client success stories, and insight‑driven narratives to deliver standout campaigns and assets.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Owning the sector marketing budget, ensuring responsible management, cost control, and ongoing value‑for‑money improvements.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Bringing the sector strategy to life across the business—building alignment, energy, and advocacy for campaign activity.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>Proven&nbsp;track record&nbsp;in shaping marketing strategy and the&nbsp;appropriate selection&nbsp;of tactics to drive a business forward and increase customer engagement and sales; use of the full multichannel mix.&nbsp; Strategic marketing experience in a B2B environment.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in professional services marketing, with a focus on Public Sector/Government clients.</li> <li>Expert relationship building and network creation – internally and with external parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Ability to work across all levels with impact,&nbsp;effectiveness&nbsp;and influence.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>A background in Business Development, Account Growth and relationship management will be advantageous&nbsp;</li> <li>Proactive in pre-empting,&nbsp;identifying,&nbsp;resolving&nbsp;and escalating issues.&nbsp;&nbsp;Self-sufficient, self-starter.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Ideally educated to Degree level or equivalent. title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Director, Slate Operations</strong> to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.&nbsp;</p> <p>Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework.</li> <li>Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change.</li> <li>Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it.</li> <li>Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing.</li> <li>Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is.&nbsp;</li> <li>Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide.</li> <li>Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean.</li> <li>Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF.</li> <li>Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation.</li> <li>Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience.</li> <li>10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team.</li> <li>You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against.</li> <li>You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread.</li> <li>You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&amp;D and live.</li> <li>You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist to help us understand what drives engagement and retention of our subscribers, and to raise the bar for how we use data and experimentation to make product decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of product analytics and data science. You'll spend part of your time embedded in our Engagement & Discovery squad, working day to day with product managers, engineers and designers as the data voice in a multidisciplinary team. The rest of your time you'll work within the Data Science team on deeper analyses and models that shape how MUBI acquires, engages and retains film lovers.

Experimentation at MUBI is growing, and you'll play a central part in maturing it: bringing rigour to how we design tests, define success, and turn results into decisions. You won't wait to be handed questions - the best person for this role is independently curious about how MUBI's business works and comes to the team with ideas of their own.

Where you'll have impact

  • Champion a culture of experimentation. Help establish the frameworks, metrics and habits that make experimentation the default way we make product decisions: design A/B tests, define success and guardrail metrics, analyse results, and own the "should we ship this?" recommendation.

  • Embed with a product delivery team. Spend part of your week inside our Engagement & Discovery squad, shaping the roadmap with data - sizing opportunities, defining metrics for new features, and making sure we learn from everything we ship.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll do This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands. At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area. In this role, you will: Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results. Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land. Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments. Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current. Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own. Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases. Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched. Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure. Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams. Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice. Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them. Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs. 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions. Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught. Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one. Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops. Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak. Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in. Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path. Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear. Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack. Nice to have traits for this role Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources. Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to. Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports. Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built. Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience. Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word. Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity. Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do. What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support you Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. Leadership Impact</strong> <strong>(Build Championship Teams)</strong></p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Liaise with fulfillment operations, logistics, merchandising, marketing, business analytics, Partnerships, and technology teams to gather information, provide key insights, and resolve issues across the organization.</li> <li>Coordinate resources, remove barriers, and work cross-functionally with external partners including marketplace operations, drop ship vendors, and MTO/3PL partners to ensure seamless operations.</li> <li>Lead and present Fan Services operational data on daily, weekly, and monthly business review calls to senior and executive leadership, proactively communicating core KPIs and delivering strategies to overcome operational challenges.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>People Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage staffing, workflows, and performance seamlessly for on-premises, hybrid, and remote employees, maximizing team performance through training, motivation, project management, and incentive programs.</li> <li>Develop succession plans and talent pipelines for managers, supervisors, and team leaders to build organizational depth and resilience.</li> <li>Deploy policies, procedures, and service level standards across the customer service organization in partnership with global teams to ensure consistent, high-quality execution.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fan &amp; description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role is responsible for making sure customers can pay successfully and that the business is not losing revenue through avoidable payment failures. This role will identify issues, bring the right teams together and ensure that changes are implemented and measured.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Role purpose</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Will be responsible for ensuring that all payment methods, payment providers and checkout journeys operate to an optimal standard across the business.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will monitor payment acceptance, identify performance issues and opportunities, and work with payment service providers, acquiring banks, technology teams, product teams and commercial stakeholders to improve successful payment completion and reduce avoidable customer friction.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The successful candidate will take ownership of payment-performance reporting, incident escalation and optimisation activity, ensuring that issues are identified quickly, investigated thoroughly and converted into measurable improvements in revenue and customer experience.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Payment performance monitoring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor payment performance across cards, digital wallets, PayPal, BNPL and other alternative payment methods.&nbsp;</li> <li>Track authorisation, acceptance and completion rates by brand, market, payment method, provider, issuer, device and customer journey.&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify deterioration, unusual trends and performance gaps requiring investigation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop appropriate alerts and thresholds so material payment issues are identified quickly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain regular reporting that clearly explains performance, causes of movement and actions being taken.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance investigation and optimisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Investigate payment failures and determine whether the cause sits with the PSP, acquirer, issuer, internal technology, checkout journey, fraud controls or customer behaviour.&nbsp;</li> <li>Analyse decline codes, authentication outcomes, technical failures, retries and abandonment points.&nbsp;</li> <li>Recommend changes to improve acceptance while maintaining appropriate fraud and risk controls.&nbsp;</li> <li>Measure the impact of changes and demonstrate the resulting revenue, acceptance or customer-experience benefit.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a prioritised payment-optimisation roadmap.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PSP and partner management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the operational performance contact for PSPs, acquirers and payment-method partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Challenge providers where performance falls below expectations and ensure issues are investigated and resolved.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hold regular performance reviews with partners and track agreed actions through to completion.&nbsp;</li> <li>Compare provider performance across markets, payment methods and transaction types.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support commercial discussions by providing performance evidence and identifying service or contractual shortcomings.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Internal stakeholder management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Technology, Product, Finance, Fraud, Treasury, Customer Experience and Commercial teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Translate complex payment issues into clear business language and explain the revenue and customer impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate internal investigations and ensure actions have clear owners and deadlines.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support new payment-method launches, PSP migrations and checkout changes from a performance perspective.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure payment-performance requirements are considered during product and technical design.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting and governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Produce weekly and monthly payment-performance reporting for senior stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide clear commentary on what changed, why it changed and what action is required.&nbsp;</li> <li>Track incidents, root causes, corrective actions and realised benefits.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain appropriate documentation for payment journeys, providers, escalation routes and performance expectations.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key measures of success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overall payment acceptance and completion rate.&nbsp;</li> <li>Card authorisation rate.&nbsp;</li> <li>Payment-method performance by provider, brand and market.&nbsp;</li> <li>Reduction in avoidable technical and processing failures.&nbsp;</li> <li>Revenue recovered or protected through optimisation activity.&nbsp;</li> <li>Speed of identification and resolution of payment incidents.&nbsp;</li> <li>Delivery of PSP and internal corrective actions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Performance of retries and recovery journeys.&nbsp;</li> <li>Customer payment abandonment and failure rates.&nbsp;</li> <li>Accuracy and usefulness of payment-performance reporting.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in payments, ecommerce, financial services or a related environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of online payment journeys and payment service providers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience analysing payment acceptance, authorisation or transaction-performance data.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes and commercial opportunities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with PSPs, acquirers or other external payment partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to coordinate technical and non-technical stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex issues clearly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Commercial awareness and an understanding of how payment performance affects revenue and customer experience.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple investigations and actions.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of card schemes, issuers, acquirers and payment-processing flows.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of 3DS, SCA, exemptions, tokenisation, network tokens and account updater services.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with digital wallets, PayPal, BNPL and alternative payment methods.&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of payment decline codes and issuer behaviour.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience using SQL, BI tools or payment analytics platforms.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of fraud controls and the relationship between acceptance and fraud risk.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience supporting PSP migrations, payment orchestration or new payment-method launches.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in a high-volume international ecommerce environment.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Personal attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Data-led and commercially focused.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proactive and comfortable challenging internal teams and external providers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Naturally curious and willing to investigate issues in detail.&nbsp;</li> <li>Able to remain calm and structured during payment incidents.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong ownership mentality with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable operating across technical, operational and commercial title: Senior CRM Manager
description: We’re on a mission to make migration easy. We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work. This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Please note we are not in a position to offer sponsorship and/or a visa for this position. What you'll be doing Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation. Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teams Enable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency. Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications. Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impact Drive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management. Who you are You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work. The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the role

This is a new role within our team. As a Senior Pipeline Technical Director for Film 2D, you'll play a central role in building a resilient, intelligent VFX pipeline that removes technical friction and keeps our artists focused on creative delivery. You'll focus on supporting and enhancing production workflows across our 2D division, covering Compositing, Paint & Roto, Editorial, and Review Tools.

From building robust Python tools to pioneering practical machine learning integrations (such as Switchlight, SAM3, and ComfyUI workflows), you'll help automate complex tasks and streamline shot delivery. Working closely with artist supervisors, heads of department, and our global pipeline team across London, Montreal, Melbourne, and Mumbai, you'll combine strong software engineering practices with a grounded, production-focused approach.

What you’ll do

  • Develop, test, and maintain artist-friendly Python and PySide tools across our 2D workflows.

  • Integrate practical machine learning solutions into our active pipeline to automate complex tasks and accelerate shot delivery.

  • Collaborate closely with Compositing Supervisors, VFX Supervisors, and Heads of 2D to proactively identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks.

  • Maintain and expand core software libraries, ensuring clean code, Git version control, and clear documentation.

  • Support and enhance deep Nuke API integrations, custom gizmos, and media processing workflows.

  • Offer technical guidance, share best practices, and mentor junior team members across our global department.


What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in VFX pipeline development with a solid understanding of 2D production workflows.

  • Expert Python development skills, with a focus on modern design patterns, clean code, and standard libraries.

  • Strong experience building custom GUI applications and tools using PySide or PyQt.

  • Deep experience with the Nuke API, programmatic control, and workflow automation.

  • Practical experience deploying machine learning models directly into production pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of open-source VFX frameworks such as OpenImageIO, OpenColorIO, FFmpeg, and OpenRV.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in a Linux environment, including Git, code reviews, testing, and performance monitoring.

  • Approachable communication skills and a user-centric mindset when building tools for artists.

You might also have

  • Hands-on experience with ComfyUI or Stable Diffusion for custom generative AI pipelines and node development.

  • Containerisation experience (Docker or similar) for deploying scalable machine learning inference services.

  • Experience with render farm queue managers such as Deadline or Tractor.

  • Web development skills using FastAPI, React, or similar for building pipeline dashboards.

  • Experience setting up CI/CD workflows in GitLab.

  • Scripting experience with ShotGrid / Flow Production Tracking APIs and database handling (SQL/NoSQL).

  • Experience guiding agentic AI workflows to design and construct scalable, well-architected solutions.

  • Prior hands-on experience as a 2D Compositor.

Accessibility Statement

Our London studio is fully accessible, with step-free entry, accessible toilets on all floors, and quiet spaces available. We are committed to supporting disabled colleagues and providing an inclusive workplace for everyone.

We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

Please note this is a hybrid role with 3 days a week in our Paris office.

About The Role

We're looking for a Territory Account Executive to join our expanding Mid Market team in Paris.

There are a few things we take really seriously here at monday.com: building an amazing product and providing the best possible service to our customers. Our clients love our product, and it's incredibly unique (and fun) to walk our clients to success using our platform.

  • The Territory Account Executive (Mid Market) position owns the full sales cycle from territory mapping, outbound pipeline generation, building relationships with key stakeholders, negotiation & contracting, to closing the deal

  • Work closely with current and prospective customers in the region as a trusted digital advisor to gain a deep understanding of their outstanding company challenges and goals.

  • Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com’s solution and connect this knowledge directly to customer ROI

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities through business development and strategic market mapping, working to meet and exceed quotas.

  • Develop strategies and coordinate cross-functional support to help customers maximize the value from the monday.com solution

  • Empower our customers to connect their goals and challenges with the solution on monday.com.

  • Partner with the customer going forward to help them grow with monday.com

Requirements

  • 3 -5 years of sales experience in a closing role at a SaaS company

  • Experience in strategic digital transformation

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills

  • Track record of success and overachievement

  • Experience navigating complex deals with multiple stakeholders, while maintaining a strong consultative selling approach

  • Driven self-starter with a growth mindset and solution oriented approach

  • Collaborative, high-energy teammate

  • Able to effectively and consistently manage time, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines

  • Native level fluency in French

  • BA/BS degree preferred; or equivalent relevant work experience

What monday.com can offer you:

  • Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

  • Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

  • Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

Biggie est le fruit du rapprochement de plusieurs entités du groupe : l’expert en activations digitales Gamned!, l’agence conseil en achat média Repeat ainsi que l’agence média & cabinet de conseil en marketing 3qtz.
 
Avec pour signature « Partners in growth », Biggie ambitionne d’être partenaire de la croissance des marques, en mettant l’excellence stratégique et opérationnelle au service de leur performance et en leur proposant un accompagnement sur-mesure (stratégie marketing, planning stratégique, data & analyse, media, performance digitale, création et adaptation de contenus ou encore consulting business) pour répondre à leurs problématiques business.
 
L’agence regroupe 300 experts, dont 150 en France, présents dans 7 pays à travers 9 bureaux internationaux (Paris, Marseille, Bruxelles, Milan, Genève, Zurich, Prague, Dubaï et Sao Paulo). Pour en savoir plus : www.biggie.co

🗒️ Missions


En tant que Programmatic Analyst, tu participes activement aux opérations, à l'analyse et au développement commercial de notre activité programmatique, en lien direct avec les équipes Trading, MediaBuying, Sales et Conseil.

Tu interviens sur des missions variées et à fort impact, allant de la création d'offres programmatiques, en passant par l'analyse stratégique des résultats et le suivi financier.

Au quotidien, tu t'occuperas de :

• Template de setup & vérification des créas : Préparer et compléter les templates de setup pour chaque nouvelle campagne, contrôler la conformité des créations publicitaires par rapport aux spécifications techniques des régies et DSP, et réaliser des audits pour identifier les éventuelles anomalies.

• Analyse des résultats des top campagnes : Analyser en profondeur les résultats des campagnes les plus stratégiques, identifier les facteurs clés de performance et produire des insights actionnables pour nourrir les équipes commerciales.

• Analyse macro des résultats : Réaliser une analyse transversale de l'ensemble des campagnes pour identifier les tendances globales, les patterns de succès et les causes récurrentes d'échec, et alimenter une base de connaissance interne.

• Compréhension de l'univers programmatique & développement du catalogue : Monter en compétence sur l'écosystème programmatique (DSP, SSP, audiences, formats), maîtriser notre catalogue d'offres, effectuer une veille active du marché et participer à la création de nouvelles offres programmatiques.

• Projections dans les Plans Média & réponses aux Appels d'Offres : Participer à la construction des projections intégrées dans les Plans Média et contribuer aux réponses aux Appels d'Offres programmatiques, en lien avec les équipes Sales.

raw.title: Engineering Manager - Java
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Connect team, reporting to Rémi Fouilloux, Senior Engineering Manager. The team is split between Bordeaux and Paris.

Together, you'll be building and scaling Mirakl Connect, an innovative solution that simplifies sellers' daily lives through a central hub powered by the latest advances in AI.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Your Impact

  • Drive technical excellence: Take ownership of user stories, conduct code reviews, and actively contribute to design, development, testing, and production deployments
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Develop roadmaps with R&D, align priorities with other tech leads, and partner with product and design teams to deliver on commitments with high velocity and quality
  • Develop talent and best practices: Ensure successful onboarding, identify and nurture team talent, contribute to recruitment, and establish best practices in clean code, testing, and pair programming
  • Remove blockers and enable success: Step in to resolve technical challenges, make arbitration decisions, and ensure the team delivers on its commitments
  • Lead and grow your team: Manage and mentor 4-5 developers, conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, and fostering team cohesion and motivation across distributed locations
  • Participate in the adoption of AI : within our products but also in internal practices 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of Java development experience with recent versions
  • Minimum 2 years in a team lead or similar management role, mentoring developers
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management
  • Track record of delivering complex projects in a microservices environment
  • Professional proficiency in English 

Skills:

  • Java development and architecture
  • Team leadership and mentoring
  • Technical decision-making and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clean code and engineering best practices

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute technical interview on Google Meet with an experienced developer to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge
  3. 1-hour business discussion with the Senior Engineering Manager 
  4. 2 x 45-minute STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders 

More information about our recruitment philosophy 👉 3 tips to shine in STAR interviews at Mirakl

 

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. title: Démonstratrice Lingerie - Printemps Lyon (Alternance)
description: Over Van de Velde Introduction Vous rêvez d’un rôle alliant élégance, expertise et passion ? Van de Velde, le groupe belge à l'origine des célèbres marques de lingerie haut de gamme PrimaDonna , Marie Jo et Sarda , recherche une démonstratrice dynamique et passionnée pour représenter ses collections premium au Printemps Haussmann .  Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans l’industrie de la lingerie de luxe, Van de Velde est un leader mondial reconnu pour son savoir-faire exceptionnel, son engagement envers le confort et ses créations innovantes. En tant que démonstratrice, vous jouerez un rôle clé en faisant découvrir la sophistication et le luxe de nos produits à une clientèle exigeante, tout en incarnant les valeurs de nos marques prestigieuses.  Notre raison d'être : "We ignite the power in women"   Chez Van de Velde, notre raison d’être est simple et puissante : "Nous éveillons le pouvoir des femmes." Cette mission s’appuie sur nos valeurs fondamentales :  Portés par la passion  Nous respirons la qualité  Nous sommes authentiques  Nous nous concentrons sur les consommateurs et les clients  Nous sommes entreprenants  Ensemble, nous sommes forts  Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d’une équipe professionnelle et passionnée, engagée pour l'excellence, avec plus de 1 500 collaborateurs à travers le monde . C’est l’opportunité de contribuer à une marque qui œuvre pour l’autonomisation des femmes et leur beauté depuis plus d’un siècle.  Missions: Vendre les marques en mettant en avant leur savoir-faire, leur qualité et leur raffinement. Offrir une expérience d'achat unique en magasin, où chaque cliente bénéficie d'un service personnalisé et d'une attention particulière. Accueillir et enthousiasmer les clientes en les abordant dès leur entrée dans l’espace dédié. Fournir des conseils personnalisés en lingerie en cabine d’essayage pour chaque cliente. Mettre en valeur les produits en assurant la présentation soignée du stand et en veillant à ce que l’espace de vente soit toujours impeccable et accueillant. Maintenir un stock suffisant pour le bon fonctionnement de l’espace de vente et répondre à la demande des clientes. Informer les clientes sur les produits, leurs caractéristiques et avantages, tout en partageant l’histoire et les valeurs de nos marques. Assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec l'équipe du Printemps pour garantir une parfaite collaboration. Profil recherché Vous avez une passion pour la mode et la lingerie haut de gamme, et vous êtes capable de transmettre cette passion à vos clientes. Vous possédez une expérience préalable dans la vente, idéalement dans le secteur de la lingerie. Vous êtes doté(e) d'une excellente présentation et d’un sens aigu du service client, avec une capacité à écouter, comprendre et conseiller efficacement. Vous êtes dynamique, autonome et à l'aise dans un environnement de vente exigeant. Vous avez une énergie positive et détectez toujours des opportunités pour mettre davantage en avant nos marques sur la surface de vente. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des tendances et êtes à l’aise avec l’évolution des attentes de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte orientation résultats et êtes motivé(e) à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs commerciaux. Notre Offre: Un contrat d’apprentissage.   Un environnement de travail autonome (shop-in-shop) avec un encadrement et un soutien personnel adaptés.  Une formation complète en lingerie styling et en connaissance produit des marques dont vous pourrez être fier(ère).  Une rémunération attractive, avec une prime trimestrielle liée à vos performances.  Un planning respectueux de votre équilibre vie professionnelle-vie personnelle.  Postulez dès maintenant pour rejoindre notre équipe et faire rayonner l’univers de PrimaDonna et Sarda dans l’un des magasins les plus prestigieux de Lyon. description: L'équipe ILF Solar Photovoltaic & Hybrid Systems intervient sur une large gamme de projets et programmes d'énergies renouvelables et de stockage d´énergie de grande envergure, raccordés au réseau ou hors réseau, pour des clients publics et privés dans le monde entier. Nous vous offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et de contribuer à des projets uniques et innovants (PV flottant, systèmes hybrides complexes, intégration de l'hydrogène, électrification rurale, etc.). Principales responsabilités Assurer la gestion de projets stratégiques internationaux dans les domaines du photovoltaïque et des systèmes de stockage d'énergie par batteries (BESS). Les clients comprennent notamment des institutions financières internationales (AFD, KfW, Banque mondiale, BERD, BEI, etc.), des compagnies nationales d'électricité ainsi que d'importants clients privés (industriels, développeurs de projets, etc.). Diriger les études de faisabilité de systèmes complexes de production d'énergie : dimensionnement et optimisation des systèmes, estimation des CAPEX et OPEX, conception préliminaire et détaillée, études de raccordement réseau MT/HT, études de stabilité (PSS®E, PowerFactory), schémas directeurs énergétiques (PLEXOS, PyPSA), etc. Prendre également la responsabilité de missions de Due Diligence Technique (TDD), de Conseil technique des bailleurs de fonds (LTA), de Conseil technique en transactions. Piloter les phases d'exécution des projets : préparation des dossiers d'appel d'offres, évaluation des offres EPC/IPP, validation des études d'exécution avant construction et supervision des phases de construction, mise en service et exploitation-maintenance. Assurer l'interface avec les fournisseurs, les contractants EPC/IPP et les clients, tout en suivant les évolutions technologiques, les tendances du marché, les nouveaux produits, les normes et les modèles de simulation. Contribuer à la standardisation des processus de travail afin d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et la qualité des prestations. Participer au développement des activités internationales à travers la préparation d'offres techniques et commerciales et soutenir les initiatives de développement commercial. Profil recherché Diplôme d'ingénieur ou formation équivalente en énergie, génie électrique ou domaine similaire, avec une spécialisation en énergies renouvelables, photovoltaïque ou systèmes de stockage d'énergie (BESS). Minimum 10 ans d'expérience dans les projets photovoltaïques et systèmes de stockage à grande échelle, associée à de solides compétences en gestion de projet et en ingénierie. Une expérience dans l'éolien et l'hydrogène vert constitue un atout. Maîtrise des logiciels du secteur énergétique tels que PVSyst , HOMER PRO et/ou des logiciels de simulation de réseaux électriques ( PowerFactory , PSS®E ). Bonne compréhension des aspects techniques des contrats PPA et EPC , notamment en matière de performance, de pénalités contractuelles et de risques contractuels. Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles. Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. 91 % de nos collaborateurs considèrent ILF Allemagne & France comme un « Great Place to Work ». Culture d’entreprise conviviale et diversité vécue au quotidien De nombreux événements locaux et interrégionaux renforcent l’esprit d’équipe, et la majorité des collaborateurs se tutoient. Nous sommes particulièrement fiers de la diversité internationale de nos équipes, qui regroupent plus de 30 nationalités. Environnement de travail moderne Sur l’ensemble de nos sites, nos collaborateurs bénéficient de postes de travail modernes et de haute qualité, équipés notamment de bureaux réglables en hauteur. Développement et réseau professionnel Chaque collaborateur dispose d’un budget annuel de formation utilisable pour des plateformes d’apprentissage externes (comme Udemy) ainsi que pour notre ILF Academy interne. Des entretiens réguliers de développement permettent d’explorer de nouvelles responsabilités ou des évolutions de carrière. Les jeunes ingénieurs se retrouvent également régulièrement au sein du Young Engineers Club . Des avantages au-delà du salaire Nous partageons les bénéfices de l’entreprise avec nos collaborateurs et récompensons les recommandations de candidats, les publications techniques ainsi que les interventions lors de conférences par des primes attractives. Les réalisations exceptionnelles sont mises à l’honneur grâce à nos Excellence Awards . En complément, chacun peut choisir entre une carte avantages Pluxee , une assurance santé complémentaire Dimension internationale et diversité Au sein du Groupe ILF, encore dirigé par ses familles fondatrices et présent sur plus de 45 sites à travers le monde avec plus de 3 700 collaborateurs, nous travaillons sur des projets nationaux et internationaux dans des équipes multiculturelles représentant plus de 30 nationalités. Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée Nous proposons des solutions flexibles adaptées aux besoins individuels, tant en matière d’horaires de travail (horaires flexibles, temps partiel) que de lieu de travail (télétravail, mobilité entre sites, missions internationales). Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité. Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou combine. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes : • Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement. • Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation. • Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète. 3. raw.title: Operations Coordinator - Lyon
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Operations at Alan

The Operations Community’s core responsibilities is to deliver at scale our insurance and health services : we build our platform and operational capabilities and run our processes to guarantee delight and efficiency.

As we anchor our Insurance position, diversify our offering with health and well-being related services in 4 different countries (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada), our operations are increasingly complex and our challenges ahead have never been as exciting!

Being an Ops at Alan means joining a team of 50+ talented, committed and passionate Ops across our countries, with a lot of interactions with Engineering, Product, Care and many other teams at Alan.

We have a mix of Builder profiles, focused on (re)designing and implementing our processes and Operations Coordinators who deliver those on a daily basis while improving them.

We want team members to deliver excellence to our companies and members and be ready to disrupt (and not only upgrade) the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare services.

Want to learn more about Ops at Alan? Read how we work and hire and watch our team in action

 

📍Join Alan’s Operations team in Lyon

The Operations Coordinator works on a specific subset of services we deliver (eg. claim reimbursement, fraud, clinic to name a few) .

Their core responsibilities (+- 70/80% of the time) are to:

  • Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

  • Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

  • Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

  • Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

  • Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

  • Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

  • Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

  • Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). This can be in a variety of ways, e.g. working with product teams to automate certain processes, enhancing our external communication, auditing our processes, automating some process steps using automation tools, …

⭐️ Our Run organisation ⭐️

Our Operations Coordinators or Ops Runners are organized in pools (3-7 runners) who are collectively responsible for running their scope. Examples of topics are:

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Claims: We provide a best-in-class claims experience, including our own optic care service. You treat claims and assist in decisions regarding our coverage. Additionally, you monitor the performance of external service providers to meet SLAs & perform quality controls. You ensure glasses get delivered on time, member satisfaction is high, our frame collection is attractive, collaboration with opticians is smooth and efficient, ….

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Note: We look for profiles able to embrace any challenge and jump in any pool ! Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. Do not hesitate to ask more concrete examples to the Operations Team Members you’ll meet during the process so they can share about their own scope.

⭐️ Experience ⭐️

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Since the scope of our Ops Runner role is extremely varied, we are open to candidates from different backgrounds : you could be a good fit for the Operations team at Alan if, for example, you:

  • Operated processes and services especially for companies during the scale up stage or in industrial/logistic industries

  • Worked in Support functions (Customer Support, People Operations etc)

  • Had a Customer facing Commercial experience, e.g. account manager or Customer Success Communications, such as Social Media, Internal/ External Communications

  • Handled event coordination

⭐️ Skills ⭐️

  • Passionate about delivering & optimizing top notch operations: not scared to get your hands dirty to get into technical processes, making them clear and delightful for our operators and members

  • A keen problem-solver and challenger with a dig deep mindset: what drives you is member and customer satisfaction !

  • Analytics skills, to be able to dive into our data

  • Highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills, with strong attention to details

  • Strong and structured in written and verbal communication in English as well as in French or Dutch

  • Able to work and learn independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Adaptable: you show flexibility and a strong ability to adapt to variable situations

  • It’s even better if you have experience in the insurance or the healthcare industry

🙌  Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

We are growing fast, with the ambition to double our team size over the next five years.</p> <h3><strong>What you will be doing - Key responsibilities</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform our clients' businesses through effective data collection, processing, and visualization, acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders.</p> <h4><strong>Delivering end-to-end analytics projects</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Frame use cases with business teams, validate data availability, and define the right approach.</li> <li>Design and implement dashboards, data products, and pipelines that drive business decision-making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Driving technical excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Translate business requirements into scalable analytics architectures and pipelines.</li> <li>Apply modern analytics engineering practices and promote best practices in data modeling and testing.</li> <li>Leveraging the latest GenAI developments in order to deliver the maximum value possible for our clients</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Being a trusted advisor</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extract valuable insights and communicate them in clear, actionable terms.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a go-to expert for analytics guidance.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Contributing to team development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Mentor junior data analysts and share best practices through workshops and documentation.</li> <li>Contribute to internal accelerators and maintain active technology watch.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Qualifications - What we are looking for</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for profiles with deep expertise in one of the following domains, combined with openness to work across others.
